title: Controllable Generative Trajectory Prediction via Weak Preference Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2510.10731v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep generative models such as conditional variational autoencoders (CVAEs) have shown great promise for predicting trajectories of surrounding agents in autonomous vehicle planning. State-of-the-art models have achieved remarkable accuracy in such prediction tasks. Besides accuracy, diversity is also crucial for safe planning because human behaviors are inherently uncertain and multimodal. However, existing methods generally lack a scheme to generate controllably diverse trajectories, which is arguably more useful than randomly diversified trajectories, to the end of safe planning. To address this, we propose PrefCVAE, an augmented CVAE framework that uses weakly labeled preference pairs to imbue latent variables with semantic attributes. translated_title: 基于弱偏好对齐的可控生成式轨迹预测
translated_abstract: 条件变分自编码器（CVAE）等深度生成模型在自动驾驶车辆规划中预测周围智能体的轨迹方面展现出巨大前景。最先进的模型在此类预测任务中已取得卓越的准确性。除了准确性之外，多样性对于安全规划同样至关重要，因为人类行为本质上具有不确定性和多模态性。然而，现有方法普遍缺乏一种生成可控多样化轨迹的方案，而对于安全规划而言，可控的多样化轨迹可以说比随机多样化的轨迹更有用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PrefCVAE，这是一种增强型CVAE框架，它利用弱标注的偏好对来为潜变量赋予语义属性。以平均速度作为示例属性，我们证明了PrefCVAE能够在不降低基线准确性的情况下，实现可控且语义上有意义的预测。我们的结果表明……
tldr: 提出PrefCVAE增强型CVAE框架，利用弱标注偏好对为潜变量赋予语义属性，从而在不损失预测准确性的前提下实现可控、语义有意义的轨迹预测。
en_tdlr: PrefCVAE, an augmented CVAE framework that leverages weakly labeled preference pairs to imbue latent variables with semantic attributes, enabling controllable and semantically meaningful trajectory prediction without sacrificing baseline accuracy.
